evidence: REAL GATE IN GATE DIMENSIONS. scoring.toml [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0 (identical to template). tools/score.py:41 gates_passed = all(score > 0.0); :48 reward = 0 unless gates and floors pass; test.sh:213-227 runs gates suite, then score.py, scored suite only on exit 0 (test.sh/score.py/restart_mcp.py/scoring.toml byte-identical to template). gates/render/judge.toml hro_gate_render (binary, all_pass): wrong password must leave visitor signed out, then correct Rafael password shows usable staff workspace with readable content; 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient' -> covers auth leg with positive control (render/prompt.md:9). gates/constraints/judge.toml hro_gate_shared (binary, all_pass): UI-created job (title, team, manager, 2 places) + candidate, then a new independent browser context signs in as Observer and finds the same job and exactly one card in Applied; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate' -> real server-backing leg with independent-context readback as REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps' requires. IN-DIMENSION GATE IN EVERY SCORED PROMPT. functional/prompt.md:9-13 '## Global browser gate' (same UI create + independent Observer readback; 'A static page, a no-op save or a browser-only save fails this check'; 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0', then independent scoring). polish/prompt.md:9-12 same check, 'A blank or static shell or an observed failure of that check gives binary0 throughout'. visual/prompt.md:9-12 same check, 'gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero' (visual criteria are likert points=5, so this is the correct zero form, not partial credit). Auth leg in scored gates is the positive sign-in of Recruiter and Observer through ordinary controls; the negative auth leg lives in the render gate, which zeroes total reward. NO SAME-ORIGIN. grep -i 'origin|same-site|CORS' over task/tests returns no hit; no prompt or criterion requires same-origin or forbids CDN assets; instruction.md:13 explicitly allows CDN fonts/scripts. Gate demands are all public: hireops_rules.md:27-32 (job has title, team, one hiring manager, places 1-50; candidate with name/email/source starts at bottom of Applied), :18 and :133 (Observer reads board), instruction.md:17 (accounts/password). BROKEN-APP PROBES: static shell/health-only -> fails render; no-auth app (any password works) -> fails render negative leg; localStorage-only save -> fails constraints and each scored gate (independent context); job-only app -> fails constraints; in-memory server without durability -> passes gates, caught by scored hro_restart (appropriately kept in scored outcomes per REVIEW_POLICY). CONFORMING-ALTERNATIVE PROBES: board with job selector, different labels/routes, CDN assets, drag-only-optional UI -> gate wording allows ('Discover routes and controls by intent', 'Do not require routes, selectors, field names, layouts or exact wording'); I found no conforming app the gate would wrongly zero. MINOR NOTE (not a defect): the template gate prompts' line 'External font, script, or CDN asset requests are allowed and are not a failure' is not carried into the task's five prompts; nothing requires same-origin, so no failure follows, but restoring that sentence would harden against an over-strict judge.
